commits.summary: Draft the application-core loop: four streams that widen native change verification to ordinary service code
Record verification results for 3 jobs: VF-021 closed, VF-014's fresh benchmark recorded
Loops print their session when they end
run-streams.sh reads only job-id-shaped words from a 'waiting on jobs' status
Draft the stub-reachability brief: decide by the solver whether a proof enters a JBMC stub (settles VF-015)
N1 done: VF-010's benchmark comparison passed, and N3 (VF-015) blocked on the user's decision
Record session traces
VF-009 and VF-019 closed by their checks; VF-018 and VF-001 deferred to the user: three of heap's JBMC tests time out at 1800 s, and VF-001's jobs fail on their own tee
Record session traces
VF-014 closed by the isolated comparison, and the fresh lib/benchmark/results.json applied on the default line: the examples stream is done
Record session traces
Merge the three cleanup streams: native, jbmc and examples
Cleanup Phase 4, step 2: the 18 run records published under their sessions' traces, with check at 0 errors
Cleanup Phase 4, step 3: the merge's examples 150-152, 160-161, 170-172 and 190-196 and lib/tests/integration.rs queued at the merge (verification pending)
prune_workspaces.py: delete jj workspaces only once nothing in them can be lost
Record verification results for the cleanup merge's 4 jobs, all passed
prune_workspaces.py only reports, and prints the delete command for a person to run
Cleanup Phase 4, step 4: the merge's four jobs passed, and the for-review list names every entry's state: the cleanup loop is done
The foundations streams' four run records published, and run-streams.sh copies a stream's records into the default workspace itself
Stub reachability, step 1: an experiment job that has JBMC's solver decide whether VF-015's proof enters the String.format stub (verification pending)
application-core: the user's decisions settled, and VF-015 brought in scope as Phase 0's step 7
application-core, prerequisite 2: the starting point recounted at the merge, and the contracts pass there
application-core: the domain-options row corrected, since the allocation bound is enforced
application-core Phase 0 step 1: the domain gate refuses a claim's domain the check doesn't make
application-core Phase 0 step 7: the equivalence harness catches the checked exceptions either version declares, closing VF-015 (verification pending)
application-core Phase 0 step 2: the four interfaces as types in spec/plans.rs, each refused until its stream builds it
VF-015: the rerun at eea1a8a8 gets past the exception property and is refused on throwing initializers
application-core Phase 0 step 3: each stream's module registered, with its call sites in the shared files
application-core Phase 0 step 5: the frozen fixtures Q, H and L, with their claims and every case's verdict
application-core Phase 0 step 4: the integration contract, one test per acceptance row a unit run reaches
application-core Phase 0 step 6: the statement and the examples' result schema register the streams' new kinds
